data.body: PS5 of Gerrit 1790: fixed a real correctness defect the LLM-Review surfaced before spending the live DC run. A LIVE bridge_sync returns NO 'plan' in its details — reconcile.py only populates result['plan'] in no-write/preview mode (nowrite_plan; reconcile.py:742-749). So the harness's post-create waits keyed on sync's plan never fired (flaky index-lag reads) and scenario 1's {one,two} <= _planned_projects(sync) would deterministically fail on empty. Fix: (a) added _wait_label_count() that polls the transport label search to absorb DC Lucene index lag (no plan/key needed); replaced every sync-plan wait loop with it; (b) scenario 1 now asserts the positive subset on the PREVIEW plan plus sync details.mutations_applied>=2. Also split scenario 7's combined pytest.raises so BOTH preview and the mutating sync legs are independently asserted fail-closed, and dropped scenario 1's tautological mapping re-read. Local: ruff/format/mypy clean, 10 collected. Authoritative live validation is the CI jira-dc-harness run (external-integration.yml), dispatched against main after this lands (the Verified gate skips the external tier).
